notes: Stream crossings are LIFETIME plays unless noted. A milestone fires only when the new figure is HIGHER than the last verified figure AND the evidence tier is SILVER, BRONZE, or REPORTED. SAMPLE and PROJECTED records never fire.

placement_rules.notes: A new VERIFIED placement on a playlist the track was not known to be on is a milestone. A position improvement of >= min_position_jump on a tracked playlist is a milestone. Reaching #1 anywhere is a milestone.
